notes.title: Update 4.3.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added [i]config_default.json[/i] file where new configurable game options will now be added. New configuration settings will no longer overwrite the file ([i]config.json[/i]) with your settings. 
[b]Attention:[/b] the game parses the [i]config.json[/i] file at startup. To add new options, you should copy them from the [i]config_default.json[/i] file.

[*] Added a new customization option to remove FPS lock.
[code]"fps_unlock":true[/code]
[/list]

notes.title: Coloring Game 4 Full Release. Three DLCs Release. 4.3.0 Update
notes.content:
After several major updates were released in the early access phase, the moment for the [b]Coloring Game 4[/b] full release has finally come! 

A compliment from the developer: the number of free images that were added during the latest update has been doubled.


[h3]4.3.0 Update features:[/h3]
- Feature to change the color of the highlighted cells.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940807/dc737238928a209db78e517f93e682598048a86a.gif[/img]

- Now you can change the hotkeys by editing the file config.json. The keys get set with the use of the KeyCode which can be found on the following website: https://keycode.info/.

- The player’s game progress is now saved in a separate file. It used to be stored in the settings file, which could sometimes lead to progress loss in case the file integrity got damaged. 

[i]Note:  if your progress is lost, you can restore it (based on your achievements) by using a key combination Ctrl+F3.[/i]


[h3]What’s Next?[/h3]

After our artist comes back from his summer vacation, he will start working on several more DLCs for CG4 that are going to be released before the end of the year. As for me, I’m getting down to a new project that is not related to CG. Minor updates concerning the game performance and the error elimination in the CG series will be released as well.


[h3]New DLСs:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1698250/Coloring_Game_4__Nature/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1698251/Coloring_Game_4__Insta/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1698252/Coloring_Game_4__2Bit_Palette/

notes.title: Update 4.2.0
notes.content:
This is the next-to-last major Coloring Game 4 update. The final update is most probably going to be released in mid-July. The full release of the game is scheduled for July 23. 


- The game now features the lazy coloring mode that doesn’t involve the left mouse button. On activating this mode, the program automatically blocks the previously colored pixels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940807/efd4ba72aaf34741e6fd4150c8449fa96a7f6cc4.png[/img]


- The interaction between the users with screens of different resolutions has been improved. Now you don’t have to include your screen’s resolution in the settings file (config.json). Besides, the number of resolutions available for the window mode has increased. 

[i]Note: the settings file doesn’t have "auto_save" field anymore since the earlier updates have provided the opportunity to use this option through the game interface.[/i] 

- For two years I studied the screen flickering problem that appeared when playing on graphic tablets. In the course of a comprehensive testing, the cause of the flickering has been identified, and a new app operation mode has been added. To use a graphic tablet, it is required to select the tablet coloring mode in the resolution selection menu. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940807/036327c2b5f9cecef92fbd0679339e309ae1800e.png[/img]


- The opportunity to activate achievements for a completed level if it was completed in the “no achievements” mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940807/3071a4678b1fc8cc7940c365681cf19b37c7e38e.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 4.1.0
notes.content:
For two years and a half we have been using JavaSript framework – NW.js  v 0.33.3 (Chromium 69). Starting from the release of this update, we’re going to use a more recent version of this framework – NW.js  v 0.52.2 (Chromium 89).
[b]UPD: Due to the problems of the new of the framework with monitors, G-Sync returned the old version.[/b]

[b]Attention:[/b] our previous experience of switching to a newer version of NW.js shows that sometimes users report false notifications of their antivirus systems. In such cases we suggest updating the antivirus database.

[h3]This update features:[/h3]
- autosave on/off button;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940807/e8f2149f46e0e4c6352b30f7a504e0ca76122c2e.gif[/img]


- new algorithm of color palette sorting (descending color numbers);

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940807/3ba319e8208d2bc3acf09989af8592f410f003d5.png[/img]


- new algorithm of the automatic color selection;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940807/646d9e3dc6269f90417a25953bdf9f6e919a1c22.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940807/2b344c504a9e7c438edf214fa2c1e0eb8d43321b.png[/img]


- opportunity to swap the preview and the color selection panels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940807/afe48d0a1d7a49f12def9cba0fddb1ae29577f8f.gif[/img]

[h3]Soon:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1622020/Coloring_Game_4__Science_Fiction

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1622021/Coloring_Game_4__PostApocalyptic_Fiction/

notes.title: Coloring Game 4 Early Access Release
notes.content:
We’re happy to announce that the forth part of the Coloring Game has entered the Early Access phase!

[h3]New options:[/h3]
- Campaign slots. Each slot enables introducing own game settings and saving the progress. 

[b]Please keep in mind that the elimination of a campaign slot will delete the whole progress permanently.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940807/deb582a12e7bbc2ca192f67e81d55f4ad54b4f27.png[/img]

- Opportunity to switch between two playing modes (with or without achievements). 


- The panel layout in the mini-map playing mode has been modified, which enabled expanding the working area by 120px.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940807/25154a69670f62aad84e9e46e16a6e4f02f7be3a.gif[/img]

- From now on, the color selection panel has no limit for the number of colors to be shown on a single page and depends on the mini-map size. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940807/d339f92e48ce09e87fe2437d5e1f88a8f4975e56.png[/img]

The next major update is supposed to be released in May.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1582820/Coloring_Game_4__Cats__Dogs/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1582821/Coloring_Game_4__Cyberpunk/
